selection: Unchanged frozen model; all 20 ordered main-head partner pairs. Same total count, head quotas and all alternative-head ticket positions.
cohort: All canonical records in the pinned September 28 source; no filtering by actual head or wins. Invalid inputs use the baseline and report the reason, never fabricated features.
timing: Save candidate tickets before reading/joining result files. Source pre-deadline timestamp and new prediction timestamp are distinct. Retrospective and pre-deadline candidate captures are reported separately; only a remotely persisted artifact before deadline supplies immutable prospective evidence.
resultPolicy: Use official saved results only after prediction save. Optional bounded live refresh: one official result request per expired-deadline cohort race; save returned raw HTML and parser output; no polling and no production file writes.
primary: Exact trifecta net additional hits; all evaluable races, not only main-head wins. No thresholds tuned after evaluation.
secondary: Equal 100-yen-per-ticket return reported separately. Refund-related/void races excluded and counted; unavailable results pending, not losses.
limitation: New day relative to this model fitting/evaluation, not a guarantee that any historical race was never viewed. A post-race replay is not a pre-deadline forecast. No performance claim on small or unfinished cohorts.
